name: code-decomposer
description: Decompose, design, and grade a unit of code on two crossing axes — SPEC (problem → contract → cases → approach → fit) and EXECUTION (compile → types/lint → test → robustness → observability) — scored separately, with EXECUTION routed to the real toolchain (a self-tested harness) and the 'green but wrong' failure routed to a test-vacuity linter + mutation + a fresh-context adversarial spec probe. Backed by a gated rubric, a spec-card + execution-report protocol, and unit-family playbooks. NOT for diff-time bug hunting (/code-review), running the app (/verify), system architecture (architecture-decomposer), quality cleanups (/simplify), or grading a proof / deductive argument on its logic and rigor (→ proof-decomposer).
